name: Scroll Card Fan
description: A GSAP ScrollTrigger card fan for React: a pinned section deals a hand of cards one by one into an arc as you scroll, each popping in on an elastic ease while the fan re-centres, then folds back into a stack. Hover lifts a card to the front; a click sends a bounce rippling through the hand.

props.name: cards
props.description: The hand, dealt left to right. `note` adds an outlined pill above the title.

props.name: spread
props.description: Degrees between neighbouring cards on the wheel.

props.name: length
props.description: Section height in screens: more is a slower deal.

props.name: fold
props.description: Gather the fan back into a stack at the end of the section.

props.name: scroller
props.description: The scrolling element, when it isn't the window.
